title: Hearth of Thorns
shortDescription: Living briar holds the glass and the light.
longDescription:
The Hearth of Thorns is half cloister and half greenhouse. Briar has been trained into trellises that remember every cut, and green light pools on the stone like water held in a leaf. Shears hang where a first-year can reach them and a second-year has learned not to rush. The air smells of crushed sap, damp earth, and the faint sweetness of something flowering out of season.
Mentor Briar waits among the living walls as if the plants had asked her to stay.
A straw hearth dummy stands where a lesson can be finished without guessing.

fixtures.name: Mentor Briar
fixtures.lookDescription: A scarred hedgehog in a green cloak caught with thorns, shears at the belt. Try talk briar.
fixtures.examineDescription: Briar's quills are patched with old scratches. The cloak is mended with vine-thread. She speaks as if the plants were listening, and they usually are.
fixtures.dialogue: Briar has the shears out and a pile of cut stems at her feet. "Thorns is growth that knows where the path is. Anything can grow. Not everything guards." She nods at the straw dummy in the corner. "Talk briar when you want to start."

welcome.text: "Green light. Crushed sap. Shears where you can reach them. Look around this hearth. The plants are listening. Then attack the hearth dummy in here, mine and not the one Flint keeps out in his orchard, unless you are still learning the spark on his. Come back and talk to me. I will open this School's leaf and ink its stem."

craft.text: "The Field Primer is your book, not a pressed flower. I open this School's leaf and ink the stem after you look around this hearth, defeat the dummy, and talk to me. Later the Primer holds ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name. Growth that is not named will snare you."

go.text: "Look around this hearth. Defeat the dummy. I will be here among the living walls. The shears stay sharp. So do I."

lessons-done.text: "The stem is inked. Cast briar at the hearth dummy for the second lesson — a vine trained, not a snare left to wander. After that, the Primer holds one ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name."

third-lesson.text: "Shears are hung up and I am leaving them there. Talk to Headmaster Alder in the High Study, up from the Great Hall. If he has you on the Clock Tower stair, finish it first. When he says the grounds will teach the rest, come back and talk to me."

third-done.text: "You are done in here, and I will not prune a student who has stopped needing it. Each lesson off the grounds leaves one ink in the Primer, and I sign the page whether I am beside you or not." She looks along the trellis. "Keeper Holm kept a stair lit so first-years would not walk it in the dark. Eat something warm before you walk a cold road."

fixtures.name: Briar Trellis
fixtures.examineDescription: The living wood has been trained into a door that is also a warning. New growth is tied, not broken. A slate says: 'Ask before you cut.'
